author: Praxis I
title: PBAGC-BalancedGraph-cosine-30-noalign: Binary Balanced kNN (cosine, 30 neighbors, no alignment)
abstract: No-alignment variant using PCA + batch-balanced kNN with cosine distance, equal per-batch quotas, total neighbors=30. Goal: characterize the neighbor-count trade-off under no-alignment and verify robustness of gains.
